entries.068db07d8d38da36: This segment comprises a total of 17 companies, including COSMO Kaiun Co., Ltd., Sakaide Cosmo Kosan Co., Ltd., COSMO Refinery Support Sakai Co., Ltd. and 14 others. Domestic transportation associated with sales is carried out by COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd., COSMO Kaiun Co., Ltd. and others.
entries.198da744f826ad6c: A holding company that handles petroleum products such as gasoline from crude oil development through refining and sales, and also deals in petrochemical products and wind power generation.
entries.228d7280300d29f5: This business develops, produces and sells crude oil. COSMO E&P Co., Ltd. oversees the business, and consolidated subsidiary Abu Dhabi Oil Co., Ltd. and equity-method affiliate Godo Oil Development Co., Ltd. and others carry out independent crude oil development and production. Under a concession agreement with the Supreme Petroleum Council of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi (concluded February 3, 2011, effective December 6, 2012), Abu Dhabi Oil Co., Ltd. carries out oil exploration, storage, transportation and sales in Abu Dhabi offshore waters. Cosmo E&P Albahriya Limited conducts crude oil exploration activities in Offshore Block 4 of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥45,224 million (103.7% of the prior-year period), the third-largest business. As of March 31, 2026, the country where its production facilities are located is the UAE, where Abu Dhabi Oil Co., Ltd. is located.
entries.2a08ee47aff7f2f2: This segment comprises one company, COSMO Lubricants Co., Ltd. COSMO OIL Co., Ltd. sells base oil for lubricants to this company, which processes it and sells it to consumers. This company is a consolidated subsidiary that researches, manufactures and sells lubricating oils and greases.
entries.39496eb8cd4b24e9: This segment comprises a total of five companies, including Cosmo Matsuyama Oil Co., Ltd., Okinawa Oil Terminal Co., Ltd., Tozai Oil Terminal Co., Ltd. and two others. To complement the integrated petroleum business from crude oil development through import, refining and sales, petroleum products are stored by equity-method affiliates such as Tozai Oil Terminal Co., Ltd. (50.0% of voting rights) and Okinawa Oil Terminal Co., Ltd. (35.0% of voting rights).
entries.39e74a3223b5a4d0: This segment comprises a total of five companies, including COSMO Oil Co., Ltd., COSMO Business Associates Co., Ltd. and three others, and buys, sells and manages real estate.
entries.4f3d8d1b807cfa24: This business produces and sells petrochemical products such as ethylene, mixed xylene, paraxylene, benzene, toluene and petrochemical solvents. The main companies are Cosmo Matsuyama Oil Co., Ltd., CM Aromatics Co., Ltd., Maruzen Petrochemical Co., Ltd. and Keiyo Ethylene Co., Ltd., and a total of 14 companies, including 10 others, belong to it. Feedstocks such as naphtha are sold to the group's petrochemical companies from the oil business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥288,277 million (97.1% of the prior-year period), making it the second-largest business. Weak product market conditions have continued.
entries.55163cab9f3e38b5: This segment comprises one company, COSMO Business Associates Co., Ltd., which is entrusted with accounting, finance, purchasing, general affairs and personnel-related work for the group. The company was merged into the company through absorption effective April 1, 2026.

entries.9fe5806b163de59f: This business supplies and sells electricity generated by wind power. COSMO ECO POWER Co., Ltd., Ifuka Eco Park Co., Ltd. (Ehime Prefecture), and Akita Wind Power Research Institute Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, among others, carry out wind power generation, and a total of five companies, including two others, belong to this segment. As of March 31, 2026, COSMO ECO POWER Co., Ltd.'s wind power generation facilities are located in Arida District, Wakayama Prefecture, among other places. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,138 million (122.7% of the prior-year period), an increase due to the start of operations at new sites, among other factors. It is the smallest business of the reportable segments.

entries.d0b5e96bd119cd50: This segment comprises a total of eight companies, including COSMO Engineering Co., Ltd., COSMO Trade & Service Co., Ltd. and six others. COSMO Engineering Co., Ltd. carries out construction and maintenance and repair work on the group's refinery facilities. COSMO Trade & Service Co., Ltd. sells car care products to affiliated service stations and carries out insurance agency business and others.
entries.e03d54b453f6d892: This business produces and sells gasoline, naphtha, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, crude oil, lubricating oil, liquefied petroleum gas, asphalt and other petroleum products. It purchases crude oil from oil-producing countries, trading companies, partners and group companies such as Abu Dhabi Oil Co., Ltd., refines it into petroleum products at refineries, and sells them to general consumers through affiliated dealers via COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd. Some large-volume consumers are supplied directly by COSMO OIL Co., Ltd. and COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd. Petrochemical feedstocks such as naphtha are sold to the group's petrochemical companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,298,768 million (95.1% of the prior-year period), the largest of the reportable segments, and it was affected by fluctuations in crude oil prices. The largest customer is Kygnus Sekiyu K.K., with sales of ¥331,890 million, accounting for 12.4% of total consolidated sales. Kygnus Sekiyu K.K. is also an equity-method affiliate in which the company holds 20.0% of the voting rights.
entries.f4fdaafe319ca75b: This segment, the one with the most companies, comprises a total of 23 companies, including COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd., COSMO Oil Sales Co., Ltd., COSMO OIL Co., Ltd., COSMO Energy Solutions Co., Ltd. and 19 others. COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd. sells petroleum products and provides car leasing and other services, and COSMO Energy Solutions Co., Ltd. sells petroleum products, environmental materials and supplies. Zixis Corporation, an equity-method affiliate in which the company holds 40.0% of the voting rights, sells liquefied petroleum gas (LPG). COSMO Oil Property Service Co., Ltd. was merged into COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd. through absorption effective April 1, 2026.
